messages:
Maya: Quick heads up — HelioPharm just paused the POC. Legal emailed that the regulator flagged cross-border data flow and export controls. They're putting the deal on hold until we provide an exec-level plan.
Ajay: What exactly did Legal flag? Can they accept a Dedicated EU-hosted deployment or do they require on-prem? Any specifics on KMS/HSM?
Priya: Customer says regulator insists on full data residency and a signed attestation that model inference doesn't leave their network. They won't proceed without it. Sections 3,4,7 of their questionnaire are marked blocker.
Leo: We do have a Private option (VPC/on‑prem) but realistic timeline is 3–6 weeks. Shorter path: Dedicated EU with BYOK + no egress commitments as an interim. Need to know if attestation language needs cert-level promises.
Sam: Ops note — Dedicated EU spin-up can be fast if prioritized, but we need IP allowlist + peering details. On‑prem will require procurement + staging. Also: export-control review needs Legal/Compliance sign-off.
Maya: Customer exec asked for an executive bridge Friday EOD. Need Legal + Product + Eng on the call. Can someone from Legal join? @Nina_legal?
Ajay: I can draft a 2‑page technical brief in 48h: what we can commit to (BYOK, no egress, audit logs) and the caveats (model weights access, latency implications). @Priya — drop the questionnaire here.
Priya: Uploaded the questionnaire: <https://files.redwood/helio/helio-poc-questionnaire.pdf>. They highlighted the attestation template they want. Screenshot of Legal email attached.
escalation_bot: INCIDENT created: E-POC-2026-234 • priority=P1 • owner=Maya • link=https://incidents.redwood/E-POC-2026-234
Leo: Proposed interim offer: Dedicated EU (no egress), Reserved capacity pilot (60 days), BYOK via KMS integration, SOC2+ISO attestation provided as existing certs. Commitment: provide migration/on‑prem plan if regulator insists.
Sam: Ops ETA if prioritized: 8–10 business days to provision Dedicated EU with peering + BYOK. On‑prem package ~4–6 weeks depending on site access and procurement. We need IPs and peering contacts by EOD tomorrow to hit the earliest window.
Maya: Who can join the Fri 15:00 UTC exec bridge? Need Product, Eng, Ops, Legal. @Ajay @Leo @Priya @Sam @Nina_legal please confirm.
Nina_legal: I can join Fri 15:00 UTC. I'll need to review the attestation text before the call — don't promise cert timelines. Legal can't guarantee export clearance timelines but can propose contractual mitigations.
Ajay: I'll prepare a short runbook + list of technical caveats and fallback options (masked/anonymized demo, tokenization). Will share by Thu EOD.
Priya: Customer said they would accept a masked-data demo as a stopgap for meetings. That might buy us time.
Maya: Great. I'll set up the exec bridge and include the draft SOW and the proposed 60-day pilot terms. Also looping Sales leadership for exec commitment.
Sam: Ops reminder: to make the Fri timeline realistic we need: 1) customer IP ranges, 2) contact for peering, 3) KMS BYOK certs. Please get those by EOD tomorrow.
Maya: On it — I'll request IPs and cert contacts from the customer now and update this thread. Will escalate to AE leadership if we don't get answers by tomorrow noon. :thumbsup:
notes: This thread represents an internal exec escalation for an enterprise POC blocked by regulatory/attestation requirements. Messages are in chronological order and reflect typical short Slack coordination between Sales, Eng, Product, Ops, and Legal.
